audience: small sales teams who manage contacts, companies and deals in CentralStationCRM

useCases.title: Review deals and the total value of all deals
useCases.text: The AI lists deals by state, pipeline, company or responsible user, and reads the number and total value of all deals.

useCases.title: Find a contact and their related records
useCases.text: The AI finds a person by name, email or phone and reads the record with its companies, deals and tasks.

useCases.title: List open tasks by due date and owner
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks by open or closed state, due-date range and responsible user, such as to-dos, calls and visits.

useCases.title: Create or update a deal
useCases.text: The AI looks up the pipelines and stages and the company, then creates a deal with value and target date. It can move a deal to another stage or set it to won or lost.

useCases.title: Add or update a person or company
useCases.text: The AI creates a person, with email addresses and phone numbers, or a company, or changes fields of an existing one. Nothing is sent to the contact.

useCases.title: Add a note or create and complete a task
useCases.text: The AI adds a note to the history of people, companies, deals or projects, creates a task for a user, or marks a task done.
